exploit_name: cumulativePrice is corrupted when price updates are rejected
description: The function updates snapshot.cumulativePrice before performing the slippage deviation check. When the check fails and the function returns false, the cumulative price remains modified, corrupting the TWAP.
attack_scenario: Attacker submits a price update that fails the deviation check. cumulativePrice is already corrupted. Subsequent legitimate updates compound the error. Eventually TWAP becomes so divergent that valid operations revert.
root_cause: The function updates snapshot.cumulativePrice before performing the slippage deviation check. When the check fails and the function returns false, the cumulative price remains modified, corrupting the TWAP.
fix_description: Move the slippage check before updating cumulativePrice, or compute the update in a local variable and only persist after validation passes.
notes: The TWAP diverges permanently. Subsequent updates accumulate errors, causing legitimate operations to fail slippage checks (DoS) or attackers to exploit corrupted TWAPs.
